items.title: Canvas overlays, Area placement bar, and compact Situational cards
items.do: Put Aveline Prone or Grabbed (or unload a weapon on Kaela), check the HUD Situational tab, then use Ogre Chieftain's Ground Slam or a Burst/Line Area Action to preview placement on the map.
items.expect: Situational cards are compact (Prone shows Stand/Crawl, Grabbed/Immobilized shows Break Free, unloaded weapon shows Reload); Area placement shows a HUD bar with enemy/ally/blocked counts, gold target rings, and No Line of Effect plates on blocked tokens.

items.title: Clean Took line (state badges only) and Resist/Weak/Immune in breakdown
items.do: With Aveline (Longsword), apply Slash damage to an Orc Warrior that has Resist Slash 2 (making it Bloodied), and apply lethal damage that puts a target Down (both Bloodied and Strained, or damage at/past its Health Pool).
items.expect: The post-Apply Took line shows only "Took ♥ N" plus Bloodied, Strained, or Down (never Resist/Weak/Immune pills), Undo and Card sit cleanly on one row without wrapping, and clicking "=" opens the breakdown ledger showing Resist Slash −2 cleanly.

items.title: Aveline & Durgan L1 automations (Courage, Thwart Cut, Brace, Seizing Cut)
items.do: With Aveline, use Commandment (Courage) while Daunted (from Grave Wisp) and check rolls/movement toward Grave Wisp; use Thwart Cut to apply Pressed then move Aveline out of Reach. With Durgan, use Hold the Line (Brace) then move Durgan; use Seizing Cut Tier 3 to Grab an enemy and check hands / Release (0 AP).
items.expect: Courage Aura 3 lets Aveline and allies inside ignore Daunted's Bane and movement restriction; Thwart Cut's Pressed ends automatically when Aveline stops threatening; Brace leaves a fixed 1-round Difficult Terrain Zone on the original adjacent squares even after Durgan moves; Grabbing occupies Durgan's free hand and Release (0 AP) offers "Let go of <target>".

items.title: Sylwen & Kaela L1 automations (Quick Shots, Darting Blade, Spotter, Footwork, Circling Shot)
items.do: With Sylwen, score a Critical on Quick Shots; use Darting Blade with a Dagger worn (not in hand) and finish Evade 2; use Spotter (Find the Gap, then shoot a target in Cover; and Keep Low while in Cover). With Kaela, use Footwork (Hands Busy) and Circling Shot Tier 3.
items.expect: Quick Shots Critical grants +1 AP when applied; Darting Blade draws the Dagger with Setup and prompts to stow it when Evade 2 ends; Find the Gap lowers target Cover 1 level (Total stays Total) and Keep Low raises Sylwen's Cover 1 level up to High; Footwork Hands Busy offers free Interact and Reload buttons; Circling Shot Tier 3 auto-starts Evade 1 that refuses squares farther from the target.

items.title: Playtest NPC automations (Dirty Trick, Overhead Smash, Rally the Tribe)
items.do: With Goblin Sneak, land Dirty Trick Tier 2 or 3 on Aveline. With Ogre Chieftain, land Overhead Smash Tier 2 or 3 on a Bloodied target, and at Escalation 4+ use Rally the Tribe near an Orc Warrior and Goblin Sneak.
items.expect: Dirty Trick automatically applies 1 Pressure Bane on Aveline's next roll; Overhead Smash folds Bloodied's +1 Push into a single Push 3; Rally the Tribe shows a 5 Emanation targeting allies and automatically applies 1 Support Boon on their next [Weapon] Action.
